title: Welcome and Project Mission
text: Welcome everyone. Today we present Track C, an integrated system for speech delivery analytics. Our platform compares participant recordings against an effective same-content baseline, isolates acoustic deviations, grounds temporal flaws with millisecond precision, and provides deterministic, evidence-backed feedback.

title: The Art of Persuasion
text: Effective leadership requires clear and engaging communication. When a speaker rushes through key concepts or delivers ideas in a flat monotone, listeners lose interest. By balancing energy, modulating pitch, and pausing strategically, we ensure our ideas resonate with clarity.
